investigator.method: Phase B deep-dive activation-readiness investigation (BEATMAPPED-LONDON-SECOND-LIVE-TRANCHE-01), superseding the Level-1 triage london-t2-watford-colosseum-01. Escalates to Level 2 STRUCTURAL: real unauthenticated GETs (curl, descriptive research User-Agent, redirects followed, 20s timeout, no retry, no auth/CAPTCHA-bypass, no browser) to the programme/events index page and three real individual event detail pages, comparing JSON-LD, list-card markup and hero-detail markup across all four retrieved pages to classify acquisition method and assess every governed field.

probe_history.reason: Mirrors/cites the prior investigation london-t2-watford-colosseum-01's own retained Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC probe (a single bounded homepage GET performed as part of a triage-refinement batch). That probe honestly recorded field_assessment.title/start_date as only PARTIAL -- individual show titles/dates were visible in the retained excerpt but no systematic per-event extraction or field-level proof was attempted at Level 1. This record continues that investigation rather than repeating it: Level 1 is retained here as INSUFFICIENT for the deep-dive activation-readiness questions this package must answer (acquisition_class, per-event field basis, collector family, offline proof).

Real unauthenticated GETs to the /events programme page and three real individual /events/<slug> detail pages (Fun Lovin' Criminals, 10cc, Francis Rossi) fully answered every open question: the platform is a custom AEG-hosted venue CMS (aeg-media-assets.b-cdn.net asset CDN; identical event-hero__title/card__title/card--horizontal--event markup conventions to the sibling AEG venue Eventim Apollo); every page carries exactly one application/ld+json block (WebSite/MusicVenue/BreadcrumbList) and never a per-event schema.org Event/MusicEvent block; each event's own title, complete day+month+year date, and doors time are stated directly and unambiguously in plain server-rendered HTML on both the list card and the detail page hero. No JS bootstrap/page-data blob, private endpoint, or client-side rendering was found or needed -- static structural inspection fully exposed the acquisition path, so no Level 3 browser observation was required.

identity.notes: Prior investigation already proved identity via a retained JSON-LD MusicVenue block at the exact given address. This record's retained /events index and all three retained event detail pages carry the identical JSON-LD identity block ({"@type":"MusicVenue","name":"Watford Colosseum","address":{"streetAddress":"Rickmansworth Rd, Watford WD17 3JN"}}), and every detail page's own JSON-LD mainEntityOfPage/BreadcrumbList entries self-declare the page as www.watfordcolosseum.co.uk/events/<slug>, consistent with the given official site.

site_classification.platform: Custom AEG-hosted venue site (same platform family as sibling AEG venue Eventim Apollo -- shared aeg-media-assets.b-cdn.net CDN and shared event-hero__title / card__title / card--horizontal--event markup conventions). The programme page and individual /events/<slug> detail pages are all server-rendered plain HTML with no client-side rendering required to expose event data. A single schema.org JSON-LD block (WebSite/MusicVenue/BreadcrumbList) is present on every page retrieved, but no page anywhere in the retained sample carries a schema.org Event/MusicEvent JSON-LD block -- title/date/doors-time are only ever present as plain HTML text.

title.notes: Each sampled event's own <h1 class="event-hero__title"> on its detail page (and matching <h2 class="card__title">/<h3 class="card__title"> on the list page) states the full title directly -- no combination required. Verified identically for all three sampled events (Fun Lovin' Criminals, 10cc, Francis Rossi); reproduced offline against the retained fixture (ev-derive-script/ev-derive-output).

source_record_id.notes: Per docs/SOURCE_INVESTIGATION_POLICY.md's stable identifier rule, the per-event /events/<slug> detail URL is used, consistently across list card links, detail-page breadcrumbs, and the detail page's own JSON-LD mainEntityOfPage field, as this source's own declared canonical path for the event (self-documented stability, not merely something that looks stable) -- e.g. mainEntityOfPage "www.watfordcolosseum.co.uk/events/fun-lovin-criminals" for this event, and the equivalent for 10cc and Francis Rossi. Verified identical across all three sampled events.

blockers.description: ingestion/static-cards/collector.mjs's CARD_START regex requires an event/programme/calendar keyword to appear BEFORE a card/item keyword within the card wrapper's own class attribute. This source's real card wrapper class is 'card h-full mb-8  card--horizontal--event' (retained in ev-events-index) -- 'card' appears before 'event', so CARD_START would not match this venue's real markup as currently written. card-date.mjs's COMPLETE_TEXT_DATE date-resolution path already handles the venue's actual complete-text date format ('Saturday - September 12th 2026') without any change. Widening CARD_START to be keyword-order-independent (or matching on the leaf 'card__title'/'card__info' classes instead of the outer wrapper) is a small, well-scoped collector change to an existing family, not a new family.

reasons: Identity is PROVEN (identical retained JSON-LD MusicVenue block on all four retrieved pages, matching the given address exactly).

Acquisition class is STATIC_HTML, a resolved/supported class: the programme page and every sampled event detail page are plain, server-rendered HTML reachable via a single unauthenticated GET each, with no JSON-LD Event objects and no client-side rendering required.
A confirmed public data path exists (the /events programme page plus three confirmed individual event detail pages).

title.state and start_date.state are both PROVEN with basis DIRECT_SOURCE for all three sampled real events (Fun Lovin' Criminals 2026-09-12, 10cc 2027-03-11, Francis Rossi 2026-10-03) -- no invented year or date at any point.
source_record_id.state is PROVEN using the site's own declared canonical per-event URL (JSON-LD mainEntityOfPage), satisfying the stable identifier rule via self-documented stability.

collector_assessment.recommended_family is STATIC_EVENT_LIST, an existing, already-implemented family (ingestion/static-cards/) -- the sole blocker is MINOR (a regex widening, not a new architecture) and does not block activation.

The DIRECT_SOURCE title/start_date parse-out was reproduced offline, deterministically, against the retained fixture with zero network access (ev-derive-script/ev-derive-output, all_match: true across all three sampled events), satisfying the general offline-proof gate.
